title: Luscious Cheese-Pull Portuguese Cheese Gratin
description: A charred and gooey Portuguese cheese gratin with double cream, miso-marinated for added depth and ovo-vegetarian-friendly. Perfect as a comforting dinner or snack.
instructions: Mix the mozzarella and Manchego cheese together in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the double cream and miso paste.
Add the softened butter to the cream mixture and whisk until smooth.
Sift the flour into the cream mixture and whisk until well combined.
In a small baking dish, create a thin layer of the cream mixture.
Top with a layer of the cheese mixture and repeat the layers.
Finish with a layer of cream on top and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and charred.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Use a spatula to create a cheese pull and serve immediately.
